Job Analysis
============

Role
----
  Full Stack AI Developer

Summary
-------
  Design, build, and deploy AI-driven applications to enhance user experience and automate business processes for the Sales Planning domain.

Required Skills
---------------
  • Python
  • FastAPI
  • AI & Generative AI
  • Large Language Models (LLMs)
  • Prompt Engineering
  • Agentic AI Systems
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • LangChain / LangGraph
  • MCP (Model Context Protocol) Servers
  • Vector Databases
  • Embeddings & Semantic Search
  • AI Chatbot Development
  • OpenAI, Claude, and other Foundation Model APIs
  • GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, and AI-assisted development tools
  • REST APIs

Preferred Skills
----------------
  • User Experience (UX) Design
  • Snowflake
  • Angular / React JS
  • Good presentation skills
  • Adaptive to new technologies

Technologies
------------
  • Python
  • FastAPI
  • Agentic AI Systems
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • LangChain / LangGraph
  • MCP Servers
  • Vector Databases
  • Embeddings & Semantic Search
  • AI Chatbot Development
  • OpenAI, Claude, and other Foundation Model APIs
  • GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, and AI-assisted development tools
  • REST APIs
  • PostgreSQL
  • Oracle
  • Redis
  • Snowflake
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • CI/CD Pipelines
  • Jenkins
  • GitHub Actions
  • Git & GitHub

Domains
-------
  • Sales Planning
  • AI
  • Machine Learning

Responsibilities
----------------
  • Develop and implement AI-driven applications using modern Generative AI and Agentic AI frameworks.
  • Design and build intelligent assistants, chatbots, AI agents, and workflow automation solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Integrate AI services and APIs, including Claude, OpenAI, MCP Servers, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, and other emerging AI platforms.
  • Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures using vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval techniques.
  • Build proof-of-concepts (POCs) and pilot solutions to evaluate emerging AI technologies and their business impact.
  • Develop scalable full-stack applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
  • Collaborate with product managers, architects, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Create technical design documents, architecture diagrams, implementation plans, and user-facing documentation.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices, coding standards, DevOps processes, and AI development methodologies.
  • Stay current with advancements in AI, machine learning, software engineering, and cloud technologies, bringing innovative ideas to the team.

Qualifications
--------------
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field with up to 3 years of relevant experience
  • Master's degree with 2+ years of relevant experience.
  • Hands-on experience in Full Stack Development using modern frontend and backend technologies.
  • Strong experience in Python development and AI/Generative AI technologies.
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.

Keywords
--------
  • Full Stack AI Developer
  • AI-driven applications
  • Sales Planning
  • Enterprise Data & AI Enablement
  • Anaplan
  • Pigment
  • Go-to-Market (GTM) planning
  • performance management solutions
  • sales territory planning
  • account assignments
  • quota management
  • goal cascading
  • sales hierarchy management
  • territory design
  • account allocation
  • target setting
  • streamlined sales coverage and compensation systems
